# DST Eco

> eco.dst.llc describes the environmental work done by the people behind DST: conifer planting in the Urals (ongoing, predates the company), environmental work starting in Yerevan (not yet completed), and an open search for environmental contacts in Dubai. It is a small, self-funded effort, not a corporate sustainability programme.

## Important framing

- Nothing described here is a carbon offset. No credits are sold, no neutrality claim is made, and none of this activity is counted against DST's own footprint.
- Two of the three initiatives (Yerevan, Dubai) are stated as intentions rather than achievements, and are labelled as such on the page itself.
- Tree counts, hectares, dates and partner organisations are deliberately not published until confirmed, rather than estimated.

## Links

- [Instagram @eco.dst.llc](https://www.instagram.com/eco.dst.llc/): dated posts and photographs from the plantings — the primary record of this work.
- [dst.llc](https://dst.llc): the group's commercial work. Deliberately not cross-sold from the eco site.
